_comment: The language-neutral module facts marketplace.json has no field for. Claude Code's schema ignores an unknown key and `claude plugin validate --strict` rejects it, so the manifest is not a home for these. Keyed by plugin name; the builder fails on an unknown name, a missing one, or a reused emoji. `pairs_with` (AC-13) is optional — only a module whose usefulness alongside another isn't already derived from registers.json/extends.json (AC-12) needs one, and the builder fails on a name it doesn't resolve.
